note: Year one for this league -- no bidding history yet, so every bid below is stated as unpriced rather than borrowed from the HBGBs' 10-team half-PPR model, which would also carry the wrong reception value here. This is FULL PPR (1.0/reception, not 0.5) on the deepest pool in the system (84 startable RB/WR slots, 210 rostered) -- a pass-catching profile is worth roughly double what the same catch total is worth in the HBGBs or the Pit. Two real targets today, and neither is taken in this league even though both are gone in the other two: Michael Mayer (fresh 3-year, $45M extension, starting for the Raiders with Brock Bowers out) and Demarcus Robinson (confirmed Thursday line: 2/3 targets, 50 yards, a 39-yard TD in San Francisco's 27-7 win). My own roster is the reason both matter more than usual -- six running backs deep (Lloyd, Gainwell, Allgeier, White plus starters Walker/Hall/Tuten/Warren) but zero bench receivers and a shaky bench TE (Terrance Ferguson, an unproven rookie), so both adds fill real structural holes rather than just adding names.

targets.why: Signed a three-year, $45M extension Saturday ($30M guaranteed) and starts in Brock Bowers' place for the opener, with Raiders OC Andrew Janocko framing the absence in multi-week terms ('it's a 17-game season, we have a 70-man roster') and Kubiak's offense built around heavy 12-personnel tight-end usage.
targets.asset: role-based -- confirmed Week 1 (and likely multi-week) starting tight end in a scheme that features the position; the extension itself is a team-commitment signal on top of the role
targets.my_team_impact: A real upgrade at my second TE spot -- Terrance Ferguson is an unproven rookie with no established role behind the Rams' veteran tight ends, while Mayer has a confirmed Week 1 starting job in an offense that prioritizes the position. Under full PPR, a real target share at TE is worth chasing even as a streamer.
targets.worth: unpriced -- year one, no bidding history in this league yet. 14 teams on 100 FAAB chase the deepest pool in the system, so HBGBs or Pit prices would read low here.
targets.confidence_why: Role is confirmed by the depth chart and reinforced by real money (the extension), not just a one-week injury fill-in -- capped at medium rather than high only because Bowers' own return timeline is still unclear.
targets.competition: Bowers himself is haleymegert's; no other roster shows a visible TE hole this week.
targets.bid: unpriced -- year one, no bidding history in this league yet.
targets.drop: Terrance Ferguson -- unproven rookie TE with no established role, my weakest bench piece.

targets.worth: unpriced -- year one, no bidding history in this league yet.

targets.competition: No other roster in this league holds a 49ers pass-catcher, so no rival is specifically positioned to chase this.
targets.bid: unpriced -- year one, no bidding history in this league yet.
targets.drop: Kenny Gainwell -- buried behind Bucky Irving in Tampa Bay's backfield, the lowest-value of my four bench running backs.
